name: Four Seasons New Orleans
positioning: Riverfront luxury hotel in a landmark modernist building at the foot of Canal Street, steps from the French Quarter
best_for: Travelers who want to be steps from the French Quarter on the Mississippi riverfront
Guests who want a pool, spa and 24-hour Fitness Centre on site

facts.text: The hotel is set on the Mississippi Riverfront at the foot of Canal Street.
The hotel has direct access to the streetcar line.
The hotel is housed in a landmark modernist building completed in 1968.
The building has been recognised on the National Register of Historic Places since 2014.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The Observation Deck is on the 33rd and 34th floors.
Above each bed there is a plaster wall relief of magnolia flowers.

highlights.text: The 75-foot crescent-shaped infinity pool on the fifth floor Pool Deck overlooks the Mississippi River.
Chandelier Bar has a custom chandelier of 15,000 crystals.
Chemin à la Mer is led by Chef Donald Link.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
The Premier River-View Room has floor-to-ceiling views of the Mississippi.

considerations.text: The pool deck has four cabanas available for daily rental.
The spa is open 10:00 am to 6:00 pm Sunday to Thursday.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area with potential noise.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
